text:
Avery: Hey all, first week q: I didn't see my first paycheck hit yesterday. Offer said first pay on 3/31. Also my benefits page shows medical start on 4/01, but I started on 3/20should it be prorated? And is there still time to opt into FSA this month?
Kai (People Ops): Welcome Avery! Sorry for the stress. Two quick checks: did you complete the W-4 + direct deposit in the payroll portal? Missing tax forms can hold pay.
Avery: I filled the W-4 but I forgot to upload the bank PDF (I used a phone photo .heic).
Lina (Payroll): Hi Avery 0from payroll. Yup we need a JPG/PDF. Heic sometimes fails. If you can re-upload as PDF and set filename like `Avery-void.pdf` I'll approve manually. Payroll cutoff for the 3/31 run was 5pm PT on 3/24; if we get your details today we can include you in the next expedited run (4/07).
Avery: Uploading now. Thanks.
OnboardBot: Automated: payroll document received for Avery. Status: pending verification.
Avery: Re: benefits start date 0 shows 04/01 in portal. My offer said coverage from start date.
Sam (Benefits): Hey Avery 0 Benefits team. Carriers sometimes take a day to provision. If your hire date is 03/20 we can request backdate to that day; please DM me your employee ID and spouse/dependent elections if any. FSA? You have a 30-day enrollment window from hire; you can enroll via Benefits > Flexible Spending by 04/19.
Avery: Sweet. One more: how does PTO accrual show on first paycheck?Will I see any balance?
Kai (People Ops): PTO is prorated on the first payroll that includes your hire month. It's reflected on the paystub as "Accrued PTO" lines. If not, @Lina will add an adjustment.
Lina (Payroll): Correct. If accrual missing after pay is posted, open a ticket with paystub PDF and we'll reconcile during the next cycle (within 2 business days).
Avery: Thanks all 389 this helped.
Kai (People Ops): Glad that cleared it. Ping here if the next pay run doesn't include you and we'll escalate. Welcome to Redwood! :wave:
